| "boarding pass Tokyo this week" | Has attachment | ❌ Not found |
| "Japan Airlines boarding pass" | None | ❌ Not found |
| "Tokyo flight ticket PDF" | Has attachment | ❌ Not found |

### 📋 Possible Reasons & Next Steps

1. **Email not yet received** — Boarding passes for weekend flights (today is Oct 31, 2026) are sometimes sent closer to departure or only after online check-in. Try checking in at the [Japan Airlines website](https://www.jal.co.jp/) to trigger the boarding pass email.
2. **Email in a different folder** — It may have been auto-archived, spam-filtered, or sent to another inbox/label. Check your **Spam**, **Promotions**, or **All Mail** folder manually.
3. **Sent to a different email address** — The boarding pass may have been sent to a different email account than the one connected here.
4. **Could you provide more details?** — For example, the sender email address (e.g., `noreply@jal.co.jp`) or the approximate date the email was received, so I can refine the search.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed!
